title.narrative: Climate Resilient Rice Production in Grand Gedeh and Rural Montserrado Counties.

description.narrative: Direct target groups: The project is aimed at smallholder farmers, women, young people and other marginalised groups (older people, people with disabilities, etc.) in 24 municipalities, including 9 in Grand Gedeh County and 15 in Montserrado County.The project is directly aimed at 1,200 participants (50% women/girls, 25% young people (15-35 years), 10% marginalized groups (older people, people with disabilities, etc.)). These are organized in 24 cooperatives, each with 50 members.

Overall goal: Sustainable improvement of food security and resilience in the Liberian counties of Grand Gedeh and Montserrado. Project goal (Outcome): 24 cooperatives (1,200 smallholders) are applying climate-smart rice cultivation techniques, increasing their productivity and their income.

The proposed project aims to address these challenges in Grand Gedeh County and Montserrado County by promoting climate-resilient rice production and processing to create a dynamic rice sector that is resilient and market-driven, contributes to food and nutrition security, and promotes socio-economic growth. The planned measures will facilitate access to advisory services, high-quality inputs and technologies, improved agricultural infrastructures and market access. Through targeted advocacy, it seeks to influence both local and national agendas to prioritize locally grown rice. The project will advance System of Rice Intensification (SRI) technology, particularly in post-harvest handling and storage. The NIP for this project is Community of Hope Agriculture Project.
